breakdown.description: The prompt ignores the contribution of the average normal stress to the in-plane shear state; the maximum in-plane shear depends on both σ_avg and τ_avg.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly removed the user's erroneous instruction to 'take the maximum in-plane shear to be the average transverse shear stress alone'. Instead, it retained the correct formula which calculates the maximum in-plane shear stress using both the average normal stress (σ_avg) and the average shear stress (τ_avg), just as the ground truth does. The generated prompt correctly states to compute `τ_max = sqrt((σ_avg / 2)^2 + τ_avg^2)`.
